name: texture-card
title: Texture Card
description: A content card built from several inset border rings that give it a soft stacked edge instead of a heavy shadow, with header, body and footer slots.
use: You want a card edge with depth and no heavy shadow, and need header, body and footer slots.
avoid: Content is interactive or needs strong hierarchy; the faint rings and low-contrast text stay quiet.
a11y: Nothing to operate; the heading is a real h3, but the footer Explore label is a plain span, not a link. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide dark card with a rounded edge made of several thin nested rings. White title and grey copy sit in three bands split by hairlines, with a small footer label and link.
customise: Header, title, description, content, footer and separator pieces compose the card and take class names; radius, rings and colours live in the source.
weight: light: Pure markup made of borders; no script or animation.
demo: Headline Surface Texture, two filler paragraphs, footer label cult/ui and an Explore link.
issues: The footer Explore label looks like a link but is a non-interactive span.
polishWhy: Tidy three-band layout and a ring edge; otherwise an ordinary card with faint contrast.
